messages.content: Who has the highest number of hearts in a game of poker?

function.name: play_poker

message.content:
In a standard Texas Hold’em game the “most hearts” a single player can ever hold is **seven**.  
Each player gets two private cards, and there are five community cards.  
If all seven cards that a player can use are hearts, that player has the maximum possible number of hearts in the game.  

(If you’re only looking at the best 5‑card hand, the maximum hearts you can have in that hand is five.)
